Name: Nyapu Mirren Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[b][size=5]UPDATE!![/size][/b]
I have uploaded a new content patcher version kindly provided by @underneaththetales!! It includes options to change between longhair and ponytail rain portraits that is not otherwise provided in the base mod.
I also edited the winter rain portrait to better match that of Mirren's winter attire, instead of using his fall attire- also suggested by @underneaththetales!

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I edited and color altered some portraits provided by @Nyapu-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPCs included in the "Mirren The Florist" mod by @Specialagentjonson!

^^These were a little rushed-- apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to @Nyapu for the assets! Credits to @Specialagentjonson for the NPC mod! Credits to @underneaththetales for the Content Patcher version of my portraits![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
Special S/O to Jupm for their own wonderful take at Mirren here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40169]Nyapu's Style - Mirren The Florist[/url]
^^Not only was this a huge inspiration but also huge help whenever I struggled with the vision.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]If you download the Content Patcher version, simply download the "CP NyapuMirren" file, then extract to your mods folder![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]--OR--[/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip the replacers' file and the open the download file "Nyapu Mirren (replacers)" where you will then see "assets". This goes in your "Mirren the Florist" mod file--> NFSW or SFW doesn't matter. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.[/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39733?tab=files]Mirren The Florist - A Yandere (obsessive) NPC[/url] mod for these to work.[/color]
